result.summary: Not ready to implement: the prescribed algorithm cannot satisfy the dry-run contract.

findings.title: Define a read-only planning path for dry-run
findings.body: X4 permits reporting state as removed only after successful rmdir/unlink, while X1/K7 prohibit an inventory or emptiness test in the disposer. During dry-run those syscalls cannot execute, so the prescribed algorithm cannot distinguish empty shelves from populated ones as W5 requires. Skipping the syscalls leaves the empty-install removal plan incomplete; assuming success incorrectly reports populated shelves as removable. This affects both --dry-run and the interactive pre-confirmation plan.
findings.recommendation: Specify a dry-run-only read-only planner, exempt it from the no-emptiness-test rule, and define removed as predicted removals in that mode. Keep live deletion independent of snapshots. Test empty, populated and unreadable shelves while asserting that dry-run invokes no mutating filesystem operations.

next_steps: Reconcile X1/X4/K7 with W5 and the dry-run acceptance criteria before dispatch.
